Option Explicit
Sub Main()
  Dim words(0 To 2) As String
  words(0) = "red"
  words(1) = "green"
  words(2) = "blue"
  ActiveDocument.Tables(1).Cell(1, 1).Range.Text = Join(words)
End Sub

provenance.note: Published Join behavior; independently authored plan, no Office-host execution.

Option Explicit
Sub Main()
  Dim separator As Variant
  Dim words(0 To 2) As String
  words(0) = "red"
  words(1) = "green"
  words(2) = "blue"
  separator = " + "
  ActiveDocument.Tables(1).Cell(1, 1).Range.Text = Join(words, separator)
End Sub

provenance.note: A Variant containing a String is accepted without implicit numeric coercion.

  words(2) = "العربية"
  ActiveDocument.Tables(1).Cell(1, 1).Range.Text = Join(words, "🟦")

provenance.note: Bounded UTF-16 strings retain astral pairs, combining marks and Arabic text.

Option Explicit
Sub Main()
  Dim words(0 To 2) As String
  words(0) = "red"
  words(1) = "green"
  words(2) = "blue"
  ActiveDocument.Tables(1).Cell(1, 1).Range.Text = Join(words, "-") & "|" & words(0) & "|" & words(2)
End Sub

provenance.note: Joining does not mutate array element values, shape or ownership.

Option Explicit
Sub Main()
  Dim words(0 To 1) As String
  words(0) = String(16383, "a")
  words(1) = String(16383, "b")
  ActiveDocument.Tables(1).Cell(1, 1).Range.Text = CStr(Len(Join(words)))
End Sub

provenance.note: The native-plan string budget accepts exactly 32767 UTF-16 output units.
